text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: OH HO HO HO♪ There is no need for me to dirty my hands with an opponent of this caliber! Tsumugi-san, I shall let you have the spotlight♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヲ～
ッホッホッホ♪
この程度のお相手、
あたくし様が出るまでもありませんわね！
ツムギさん、
スポットライトはアナタに譲って差し上げてよ♪

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Of course you will. And I'm guessing you plan to swoop in and steal the finishing blow, right? You're not exactly subtle, Kanon-san.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とか言いつつ、
トドメは自分がかっさらってやる、
とか思ってますね？
分かりやすすぎますよカノンさん。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: GRRRR...! Hmph! As if someone like you could ever read me! Honestly! I suppose I must come along and help after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐぬっ……！
フンですわ！　
アナタごときがあたくしを理解したおつもりかしら！？
仕方ねぇですわ、
あたくしも一緒に行って差し上げますわよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: ...You're totally going to shove me in first as bait, aren't you? In that case, pardon me for just a moment! *Wrap wrap wrap*
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私を先に突っ込ませて囮にしそうなので、
ちょっと失礼しますね？　
ぐるぐる～
っと。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Eh?! Binding me up with thread... what on earth do you think you are doing!? I cannot move like this! W-Wait, could it be... you are planning to throw me at her?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ？　
あたくしを糸で縛るとは
どういう了見ですの！？
これでは身動きが取れませんわ！？
まっ、
まさか
このままぶつける気ですの！？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: This is our ultimate tag-team technique!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが私たちの！　
連携攻撃ですっ！

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: YOU ROTTEN O'PINK COTTON CANDY GREMNLIIIINNNNN...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんの
ドグサレおピンクーーーーーっ！？
